title: Sungrazer
description: data of: sungrazer.py fetch|look|hunt --json. fetch: how many SOHO LASCO pictures are kept. look: moving points in them that do not drift with the stars, each with a movie for a person to watch. Nothing is reported for you.

raw.description: The raw FITS pictures (--raw) rather than the 1024-pixel JPEGs.

kept.description: fetch: the folder the pictures are kept in.

star_drift.description: Pixels in 12 minutes, x and y.

when.description: hunt: the end of the hours looked at, UTC.

towards_sun.description: hunt: the candidates heading in towards the Sun.

moving.description: hunt: candidates moving other than the stars, heading anywhere.

deleted.description: hunt: pictures older than KEEP_DAYS deleted.

installed.description: hunt --install: the timer written and started.

planted.description: look --plant: fake comets planted in the real pictures and found, by strength (times the noise).

towards_sun.description: 1 straight in towards the Sun, -1 straight out.
